title: Hruday statement on state identification: what the closeness lemma does and does not establish
selection_reason: After AY1 the honest state of knowledge on roadmap goal 4 is a statement with explicit constants (2D for any two subsequential limits of either family, the common first-order density rho^(1)_R, the R-local trace-norm constant K_2' and the second-order difference bound 2K_2' tau^2) and an explicit list of unproved obligations (uniqueness, whole-sequence convergence, translation invariance, a rate in N, boundary independence of dynamics). AY1 also produced two facts the panel did not anticipate: the R-local trace-norm K_2' exceeds the single-observable K_2^+ (about 4.0 times), and the first-order density gives a certified two-sided distance of every subsequential limit from the Haar product on R. AY2 records both with exact constants and labels.
model: Same families, cover R={0,e_z}, clock and constants as AY1 (zero-selected patterned family at both signs |tau|<=10^-8).

parameters.deliverable: statement with exact constants and an obligations table; a small exact checker verifying the constants, the two-sided first-order distance tier and the mandatory sentence fields

constants_from_ay1.D: AV1 forward tier (ii), bound by the AY1 gate
constants_from_ay1.two_D: 2D <= 1/1250000 (AY1 target), any two subsequential limits at the same tau
constants_from_ay1.rho1_R: (tau/72) sum over the 10 faces with owner set exactly R of (|W_f Omega_R><Omega_R| + h.c.); trace norm sqrt(10)|tau|/72; Tr(rho1_R W)=+tau/144
constants_from_ay1.K2_prime: R-local trace-norm second-order constant from the AW1 remainder items restricted to faces meeting R, bound by the AY1 gate (about 1.34e4, larger than K_2^+ about 3.35e3)
constants_from_ay1.second_order_difference: 2 K_2' tau^2 for any two limits after subtracting the common rho1_R

parameters.first_order_distance_tier: ||rho_R - P_R||_1 in [ sqrt(10)|tau|/72 - K_2' tau^2 , sqrt(10)|tau|/72 + K_2' tau^2 ] for every subsequential limit of either family, with sqrt(10) enclosed by exact rationals (directed rounding); recorded as the labelled tier first_order_distance_from_product, never as an interaction-shift or dynamical claim

required: 1. State precisely, with the AY1 gate constants (2D, rho^(1)_R, K_2', 2K_2' tau^2), what is proved for the set of subsequential limits of both named families: uniform local closeness on R in trace norm at fixed tau, a common first-order density, and a second-order difference bound. Use the mandatory sentence template with the constants filled in; say 'a chosen subsequential'; never 'the AQ state', 'the thermodynamic limit', or 'unique' without 'not'.

2. List every unproved obligation in an obligations table with the missing premise and a candidate route: uniqueness of the limit (HTW-type local stability with evaluated constants, or a Dobrushin-type uniqueness condition at the cap); whole-sequence convergence (a Cauchy estimate in N, missing); translation invariance (translation covariance of the construction plus uniqueness, missing); a rate in N (missing); boundary independence of dynamics on compact time windows (a Lieb-Robinson locality argument with the AM2 constants; the dynamics topology is named in AY1 but no dynamics is constructed for the padded family); dynamics of the padded family itself.

3. Give the falsifying scenario: two limits differing at second order on R by up to 2K_2' tau^2 (about 2.7e-12 at the cap), and explain why the present bounds cannot exclude it; record that 2D alone is not a boundary comparison (the +tau and -tau limits differ on R by at least 8.7e-10 while both lie within 2D of the product), so the comparison content is the matching first-order term.

4. Certify the two-sided first-order distance tier with exact arithmetic: for every subsequential limit of either family, sqrt(10)|tau|/72 - K_2' tau^2 <= ||rho_R - P_R||_1 <= sqrt(10)|tau|/72 + K_2' tau^2 at |tau|=10^-8, with sqrt(10) enclosed by exact rationals and the AY1 gate values of K_2' read from the snapshotted gate; label it first_order_distance_from_product and state that it is a static property of the state on R (never an interaction-shift, Euclidean-node or dynamical claim). The lower bound shows that no subsequential limit of either family coincides with the Haar product on R; it does not identify the limit.

5. Record the K_2' versus K_2^+ comparison correctly: K_2' is a trace-norm constant over all of B(H_R) while K_2^+ bounds the single observable W; the AM2 remainder term dominates both, so face restriction cannot make K_2' smaller than K_2^+. State the labelled variants only as previews. Correct the AY1 contract wording 'not the whole-box K_2^+' (K_2^+ is volume-uniform and W-specific) in the statement.

6. Exact checker of every constant and of the gate fields; export uniqueness_claimed:false, whole_sequence_claimed:false, rate_claimed:false, rate_in_N_claimed:false, translation_invariance_claimed:false, boundary_independence_of_dynamics_claimed:false, states_compared, region, topology, closeness_order; implement every control as a damaging mutation where possible; skeptic review with independent derivation and replays.
claim_exclusions: whole-sequence convergence or a rate in N
interaction shift or dynamical claim from the static tier

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Statement, constants, the two-sided tier and the obligations table verified by the skeptic with exact arithmetic.
acceptance.limited: An obligation is missing, a constant is not exact, or the two-sided tier is not certified.
acceptance.insufficient: The statement overclaims (uniqueness, whole sequence, rate, translation invariance, dynamics).
